`.github/workflows/minds-evals-scheduled.yml` evaluates a matrix of arms: each frozen (mngr, dwt) pair times each selected harness config, one cell being one arm. A `harness_configs` dispatch input takes comma-separated names from `apps/minds_evals/configs/harness_configs.json`; empty -- the default, and what a schedule and a `minds-evals-run/**` push get -- runs the entries marked nightly, and a name the file does not hold, or a selection that names nothing at all, fails the free resolve job rather than evaluating an empty matrix.

Four jobs. `resolve` freezes the pairs, lists the green markers once with `gh cache list --key minds-evals-green-`, and runs `minds-evals ci-matrix` to decide the cells. `oracle` runs once per pair that has a running cell -- the oracle pass boots no workspace, so it is independent of the harness config -- and generates the dataset, runs and checks the oracle pass, and runs the Modal environment cleanup including the 8 h backstop sweep. `evaluate` runs one cell per running arm: it downloads its pair's oracle summary and refuses to start unless that oracle passed, regenerates the same dataset at the same SHAs (so the image build is a Modal cache hit), runs `just minds-evals-run` with its harness config's `--ak` flags appended, checks it, deletes the environments it recorded, and writes its green marker on success. `notify` renders the run's report with `minds-evals ci-report` -- one Slack message per pair -- writes each message's text into the run summary and posts each payload to the webhook; a payload Slack refuses is posted again with its text alone under a `::warning::`, and neither a missing webhook nor a rejected message turns the run red. The oracle job's concurrency group is `minds-evals-oracle-<pair>` and a cell's is `minds-evals-<pair>-<config>`.

Secrets are fetched per job and no wider. `resolve` needs none and `notify` only the Slack webhook; every job that runs a pass gets `mngr/ci/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (the judges spend it on every pass and the decider on every live one) and the Modal token pair; a cell whose config reads its lane's key from another variable additionally gets `mngr/ci/<key_env>`, so the `pi-gpt-5-mini` cell gets `mngr/ci/OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and no other cell does. A lane's key is never exported into a cell that does not sign in on that lane, and a `key_env` with no Vault secret behind it fails that cell at the fetch step, before a box is built.

A green cell is remembered under `minds-evals-green-<pair>-mngr-<sha>-dwt-<sha>-cfg-<config slug>-hc-<config name>-<digest>`, the digest being over the harness config's kwargs, so an edited config re-runs its own cells under the same name. A cell is skipped when its exact key is among the markers the run may restore (its own ref or the default branch), `force` runs it anyway, and a pair whose every cell is skipped runs no oracle pass. Every `minds-evals-run/**` push, and every run that stops after the oracle passes (`skip_live`, or such a push without `[live]`), decides every cell as if `force` were set, so a test push and a night when nothing moved both still have something to exercise. An oracle-only run writes no marker, the marker step being in the live pass it never reaches; a push writes its markers under its own ref, which a nightly on the default branch cannot restore. Artifacts are per pair (`minds-evals-summary-<pair>`, `minds-evals-jobs-<pair>-oracle-<run_id>`) and per cell (`minds-evals-summary-<pair>-<config>`, `minds-evals-jobs-<pair>-<config>-<run_id>`), and a summary artifact holds `oracle-summary-<pair>.{md,json}` or `live-summary-<pair>-<config>.{md,json}` -- named after the pass so the report can merge every summary artifact into one directory. Each matrix job is titled after the arm it evaluates rather than after every field of its matrix entry.

The `minds-evals-run` recipe in `private.just` runs its harbor line with pathname expansion off. `just` splices a variadic parameter in as raw text, so the forwarded `--ak` flags are subject to word splitting -- which is how several of them arrive as several words -- and to pathname expansion, which nothing wants: `--ak model=opus[1m]` is a valid glob bracket expression, and a matching file in the working directory would otherwise rewrite the model the run drives.

`specs/minds-eval-harbor/harness_arms.md` describes the matrix as it now stands: the harness config file, its nightly flag and the order its entries are read in, the four jobs, the per-cell secrets, the marker key, and the report -- including the blocks a webhook accepts, the coloured square a grid cell places the reward on, the table of trials that did not pass, the one collapsed judge table the pair shares, and the icon a message posts under.

The notify job never leaves a run unreported: its toolchain steps may fail, and when the report command cannot run or fails, the job posts a one-line notice naming the resolve, oracle and evaluate results with a link to the run in place of the report.

A cell writes its green marker as soon as its live pass has been checked, before it deletes its Modal environments and uploads its artifacts, so a deletion the API refused turns the job red without costing the arm a full re-run the next night. A ref whose `git ls-remote` fails outright is recorded as unresolved, the same as a ref that does not exist, so a transient failure on one pair never takes the other pair's answer with it.
